name: astro-dev-cms
description: Astro Dev CMS — authoring shell for Astro content collections (dev-mode route)

scripts.check: bun run --filter @cms/core check && bun run --filter @cms/authoring check && bun run --filter @cms/astro check && bun run --filter @cms/astro-template check
scripts.check:allowlist: bun run --filter @cms/core check:allowlist && bun run --filter @cms/authoring check:layers && bun run --filter @cms/authoring check:allowlist
